caption: The drawing depicts an elaborate floral arrangement featuring an assortment of flowers, baskets, and pots. At the top of the composition, there is a pot containing leafy green and yellow plants, with long, trailing vines hanging down. These vines are interwoven with beads, flowers, and leaves in various pastel shades such as blue, pink, orange, and green. The middle section features a central woven basket adorned with more flowers and smaller baskets on either side, supported by three legs, each with additional potted plants that contain green leaves. The central area is filled with large, detailed blooms in colors including yellow, pink, blue, and peach, surrounded by leafy stems. The base of the arrangement has a blue and green patterned mat decorated with stylized, multicolored flowers and leaf motifs, rendered in stippled patterns. The background is plain, off-white paper, and the colors used throughout the drawing are soft, with highlights of pastel hues and fine, delicate linework. The artist's signature "Nicolas J. Zaya" appears in the bottom left corner.
title: Parlor Flower Stand
